alt: Close-up of a single cross-bridge: a myosin head carrying ADP and inorganic phosphate reaching up from the thick (myosin) filament to a thin filament made of actin monomers with tropomyosin winding along it and one troponin complex marked. Labelled Tropomyosin, Actin, Troponin, Myosin head, Myosin Filament, ADP and P.
